race_courses.name: Rockwood Park, 5 km
race_courses.start_note: Start and finish on the paved Blue Trail north of the parking lot by the archery range. The loop takes the White, Red, Orange, Yellow, Green and Purple trails through the woods and returns to the Blue Trail where it meets the Orange Trail.

route_guide.getting_there: Park in the lot at the end of the park road by the archery range. The Blue Trail, which is paved, starts at the north edge of that lot; the start line is on it.
